text:
Maria: Pagerbot didn't page oncall for SEV1 alert from notify-bridge (nb-8421). Channel shows automation fired but no external pages. Anyone seeing missing deliveries?

Ajay: I see the webhook hit notify-bridge and it forwarded to incident-bot, but headers X-Pager-Routes/X-Oncall were stripped by the proxy. logs:
```
2026-03-17T07:19:21Z notify-bridge proxy: forward req nb-8421 headers: {host, content-type}
2026-03-17T07:19:21Z incident-bot: incoming hook nb-8421 missing routing header
```

Pagerbot: incident-bot: received hook nb-8421 -> queued for delivery -> DROPPED (missing routing header)

OpsBot: automation: routing-suppressor flagged message nb-8421 as lacking oncall metadata; suppression applied. See suppressor ID supp-77.

Alex: I didn't get a page. oncall here — can someone manual-page me?

Ajay: manual page sent to Alex :phone: (sid=pag-9001)

Maria: manual mitigation: re-sent payload with X-Oncall header via incidentbridge curl:
```
curl -X POST https://incidentbridge/reliable -H 'X-Oncall: team-alpha' -d '@alert.json'
```

Ajay: hypothesis: recent deploy to notify-bridge (deploy a1b2c3) introduced a header whitelist that strips non-std headers. Rolling back to v1.3.8 now. ETA ~2m.

OpsBot: deploy rollback started for notify-bridge -> v1.3.8 (id: rollback-212)

Pagerbot: reprocessing queued alerts after rollback... delivered pag-9001 -> acknowledged by Alex

Alex: got the page at 07:21 UTC. No customer-facing errors observed so far; spikes only in internal queue backlog (metrics: incident_queue_len +120 for 5m). Investigating whether any downstream webhooks failed.

Maria: created incident INC-2026-204 and assigned eng-infra + oncall. Short-term: rollback fixed immediate page delivery. Long-term actions: add integration test for header passthrough, add alert smoke test that triggers test page on deploy, add monitoring for suppression counts.

Ajay: PR opened: add-header-whitelist-e2e-test -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/notify-bridge/pulls/1245

Alex: I'll run post-incident customer-impact assessment and update the incident doc in 30m. If anyone saw missed customer pages or external pages, ping me.

Maria: thanks — good catch by Ajay's log check. We'll follow up in postmortem with timeline and mitigation.
